description: Matt has spent his career standing up for the communities, land, and waterways that make South County such a special place to call home. From protecting forests and restoring rivers, to organizing with neighbors, his focus has always been the same: showing up and getting results. Matt is ready to bring that experience to the General Assembly and make sure South County has a strong, effective voice—one that listens, fights back when it matters, and always puts our communities first.
title: Matt Johnston for Delegate
